parameters.query:
update seo_audit.leads l set review_requested_at = now()
where l.id in (
  select id from seo_audit.leads
  where review_requested_at is null
    and created_at > now() - interval '120 days'
    and (followup_sent_at < now() - interval '5 days'
         or (followup_sent_at is null and created_at < now() - interval '7 days'))
  order by created_at
  limit 20
  for update skip locked
)
returning l.id, l.name, l.email, l.audited_url;
